title: VooPoo PnP X Replacement Pods (MTL) - 2 Pack
description: The Voopoo PnP X Cartridge MTL is specifically crafted for Mouth-To-Lung vapers using the stunning Voopoo PnP X Pod Kit. These replacement pods are designed to deliver a premium MTL experience, emphasizing flavour and a satisfying throat hit. Sold in convenient packs of two, these cartridges ensure you're always ready to go with a fresh pod at hand. The pods in this pack feature a 2ml e-liquid capacity, providing ample space for your preferred MTL e-liquids. The pods are designed for use with the Voopoo PnP X Pod Kit, ensuring a secure magnetic connection and optimal performance. These MTL pods are compatible with PnP X Coils, giving you the freedom to choose your preferred PnP coil resistance based on your preferred vaping style and e-liquid choice. Whether you're at home, at work, or on the go, the Voopoo PnP X Cartridge MTL pods offer a convenient and easy way to enjoy your MTL vaping sessions. Their straightforward design makes replacing pods hassle-free, ensuring a clean and efficient vaping experience every time. Please Note: These pods are ONLY compatible with Voopoo Drag S2 pod vape kit and Voopoo Drag X2 pod vape kit
